description: budget.show is the single-budget read: the view, the spend breakdown with P31's honesty marks (the floor, the partial/unknown counts beside it, exact saying when the floor is a total), the OPEN loops the budget currently covers, the audit trail (oldest first, the screen's window), and the worst-case overshoot note — how far past the cap ONE MORE STEP could spend before the next check fires, honest arithmetic over the priced routes' bounds, never a promise.

result.overshootNote: one more step can spend up to $12.42 before the next check fires (worst case over priced routes: claude-opus)
